title: Quantum Flat Connections, KZ equations, and Integrability
summary: N=2 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories are described in terms of a Hitchin system over a Riemann surface C. Focusing on strongly coupled Argyres-Douglas theories, we show that the corresponding flat bundle over C can be quantized such that the resulting quantum flat connection is integrable. For $sl_2$, the quantum connection takes values in $gl_2$(A) where A is an associative algebra which we explicitly describe for the cases of Painlevé I, II and IV.
